crossRefs.note: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Gerar
people.line: Philistine city; Abraham and Isaac's encounters with Abimelech

people.name: Kadesh
people.line: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

people.name: Shur
people.line: Wilderness area between Canaan and Egypt

translations.web: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
translations.bsb: Now Abraham journeyed from there to the region of the Negev and settled between Kadesh and Shur. While he was staying in Gerar,
translations.kjv: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
translations.asv: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the land of the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur. And he sojourned in Gerar.
